text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d be glad to help build your PTE writing checker API.

With 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP, I can design an API that accepts an essay payload and returns JSON scores based on the scoring rules from the Pearson PTE PDF. I’ve worked with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, so I’m comfortable building both the scoring logic and the API layer.

In a recent telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read, achieving AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter and 3.1x top-decile lift.

I’d be happy to help turn the PTE scoring criteria into a reliable REST API.
